granted_by: maintainer (formal authorization message 'H1-PA PA2 Formal Authorization', received 2026-10-24 UTC / 2026-10-25 +08:00)
decision: Maintainer approves H1-PA's formal GPU validation (PA2v) and student recovery (PA2) as one phase: PA2v, four D4 trainings, six nucleus_v1 evaluations of eval-set-1, the preregistered analysis, cost reconciliation and provider cleanup; PA2 follows a passed PA2v gate without a further approval; effective once the two pre-launch fixes are committed

required_fixes.provider_fail_closed: h1pa_governance.live_position refuses unless the balance, the resource listing and both billing queries are confirmed (snapshot_problems); provider_billing.fetch keeps the resource listing's own known state
required_fixes.step_floor: h1pa_launch.pricing: step_seconds = max(committed L40S rate, PA2v measured median)
required_fixes._harness: supersedes the application's e86adfc9...; every authorization recomputes the harness on its own session commit and PA2v's gate must name the formal session's harness

arms.PCA-Original: E1's two PCA 2.96M checkpoints, evaluate only, never retrained or deleted
arms.D4-Original: E1's original training set and recovery config, two seeds
arms.D4-Augmented: E1's training set + the 2,962,514-token fluid increment, two seeds

fixed.recipe: E1's batch size, micro-batch size, optimizer, loss, tokenizer and training algorithm
fixed.evaluation: eval-set-1, every item, the frozen nucleus_v1 decoding protocol, generations, sampling seeds, stop reasons and per-item scores recorded
fixed.statistics: logs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/plans/h1pa_preregistration.json, unchanged; FLOOR, INCONCLUSIVE and NOT_RESOLVED are valid outcomes; no completed formal measurement is rerun

PA2v.scope: H1-PA PA2v GPU validation on L40S: real CUDA, the training config, checkpoints, SIGKILL/resume, persistence, nucleus_v1 and throughput; never a formal result

PA2.scope: H1-PA PA2: the four frozen trainings (D4-Original and D4-Augmented x two seeds), the six nucleus_v1 evaluations, and their closeout

ceiling_scope: CUMULATIVE over PA2v and PA2: every attempt, engineering recovery, GPU, container disk, the network volume's storage and termination margins together; no session or attempt receives a fresh allocation
_project_cap: raised by the maintainer from $712.17 to $731.00 for this phase; neither $50 nor $731 may be raised without a new maintainer decision
_occupancy_basis: provider all-time billing (pods + network volumes) at the grant, 0 pods, 0 volumes, $0/h (snapshot below); H1-PA sessions and storage are added from their records by remaining_envelope, and live_position re-reads the provider at every issue and launch

storage.rule: its whole cost, booked at its reservation until retired or trued up, is inside the ceiling; the four new checkpoints are kept until the formal analysis and the independent scientific review are complete, then a consumer audit and a migration or retirement proposal go to the maintainer

gpu: NVIDIA L40S; one GPU type for every formal unit
order: create the 30 GB volume in an L40S datacenter and check the provider-reported size
PA2v under its own one-use authorization; its gate must pass
reprice from the saved real results, then PA2-s20260801
every evaluation, the preregistered analysis, cost reconciliation, provider cleanup
on_failure: ordinary engineering failures are repaired inside the envelope; a valid checkpoint is reused, an interrupted training resumes from its save point, a trained unit is not retrained, an evaluated unit is not regenerated; a deterministic failure is never retried unchanged on a paid GPU; one billing pod at a time; each session has its own authorization, closeout and cost evidence
budget_boundary: if PA2v's measurements show the study cannot complete inside $50, stop before creating a formal PA2 pod and report the real gap; never cut evaluation items, epochs, steps, samples or a seed
terminal: SUCCESS, a scientific terminal (GO / NO_GO / INCONCLUSIVE / NOT_RESOLVED / REVERSED by the frozen rules) or a hard boundary (budget, safety, hardware or artifact identity)
